scope: Both directions of the internal angle-bisector theorem for a strict cut of a nondegenerate triangle base; actual positive length ratios and source equimultiple formulation.
proof_spine: Use VI2 interior affine parameter for the base cut: AD=(1-t)AB+t AC.
Read angle equality via the existing normalized cosine interface; factor each positive angle denominator into side length times AD length.
Bilinearity gives the two numerators. Their normalized difference factors as ((1-t)*AB-t*AC)*(AB*AC-dot(AB,AC))/(AB*AC).
The second factor is nonzero by Gram identity and noncollinearity; cancel it for the forward direction.
The reverse ratio makes the first factor zero, so normalized cosines and therefore the source angles agree.
Use actual segment scaling for BD/DC=t/(1-t), then reuse only required equimultiple lemmas.
